query:
SELECT leagueId, category, COUNT(*) as cnt,
  MIN(FROM_UNIXTIME(kickoffUtcMs/1000)) as earliest,
  MAX(FROM_UNIXTIME(kickoffUtcMs/1000)) as latest
FROM matches
WHERE category = 'uefa'
GROUP BY leagueId, category
ORDER BY leagueId;
